infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Commune uses Face ID to unlock the app when you turn it on in Settings.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Commune uses the camera to photograph receipts when you add an expense.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Commune lets you choose a receipt photo when you add an expense.

plugins.contactsPermission: Commune opens your contacts only when you choose someone to invite. It uses the one person you pick to write the message, and uploads nothing.
